shared_fixes.fix: Regression from iter1 #18. In _cloud, use subdiv=2 for the puff spheres and subdiv=3 for the core, built with smooth=True and sharp_angle=180. Keep 5-7 puffs; because they are instanced, only two meshes change. Thin the Cloud_CliffBase collar: skip about 60% of ring points instead of 45%, use larger and flatter puffs, and push z to -110..-170, so it reads as separate soft puffs, not a rubble band. Peak halos (second request, iter1 9d): either 8-10 flattened puffs on a ring at about 0.5*rad + puff radius, only on Mountain_Peak_Rocky, or drop halos entirely. Budget: about +300-350k triangles on WORLD, which is at 2.87M of 3.5M.
shared_fixes.rationale: I viewed Island_Overview and Island_WorldMapStyle myself. The faceted cloud collar runs the full length of the south side and reads as white rubble in every island and hero shot. It is the most visible regression on the island and a one-parameter fix.

shared_fixes.fix: Second request (iter1 #4). For every trail row, raycast the map ground (map terrain plus plinth caps). Wherever a map surface is within ±0.05 m of the trail top, or above it, sink that row 0.03-0.05 m below the map surface or clip the solid there. Start the trail solid at the footprint edge. From the edge to the portal, lay a path_ribbon in the trail's top material, lifted 0.02-0.03 m, with a rounded end and a short taper or blend into the in-map path. Worst aprons to re-check: 1020000 west00 (0.63 m above map ground), 1000000 in05 (0.49), 1000006 out00 (0.41), 1000000 in00 (0.38), 1020000 in00 (0.36), 40000 in00 (0.32). Acceptance: the junction probe finds 0 coplanar samples at all 40 ends and no apron more than 0.05 m above map ground. Because this moves trail geometry, add the trail-walk check in the same change: after world.trails(), walk each trail from the last route point near portal A to the first near portal B, using a ground index of both maps plus World_Trails and the plinth caps and reusing check_route. Store the results in build_report.trails, make validate.py fail on errors, and add World_Trails instances to the floating-props test.
shared_fixes.rationale: 25 of 40 trail ends are coplanar with map ground. The result is z-fight stripes and pale rectangles at the portals, on the main route, in every region shot. Nothing currently validates the walk between maps.

shared_fixes.area: Gameplay-frame scale proxies (scripts/validate.py, mapkit). Wave 0: land this before map authors start.
shared_fixes.fix: Add a check, player_in_gameplay_frame. For every exterior map, require a Player_Proxy to exist. Project it through CAM_<slug>_Gameplay with bpy_extras.object_utils.world_to_camera_view, and require 0.1-0.9 on both axes with z > 0. For hunting maps, also count mob proxies inside the frame and require at least 2. Make build_map.py print the result, so map authors can verify their moves without a full island build. Option, also Wave 0 since it is a kit change: scale Mob_Snail, Mob_BlueSnail and Mob_RedSnail about 1.3x after checking them against the player proxy (40001's snails are 25-30 px at scale 40), then re-run the floating-props and props_near_routes checks.
shared_fixes.rationale: DoD 13, 19 and 22 depend on the representative Gameplay renders. Two of them that were viewed (10000, 60000) show no player. 1000005 and 1000006 never call m.player (verified). About 10 more are probably out of frame, but that is from module distances, not projections, so authors need a real check to hit.

shared_fixes.area: Long straight trails and layout (layout.resolve/LINKS, trails.build_trail). Parallel with the map wave, but finish before the final renders.
shared_fixes.fix: Second request (iter1 3e). (a) In resolve(), print which footprint each auto-lengthened link clashes with. Write a LAYOUT_WARN to build_report when a final gap exceeds 1.5x its authored value or grows by more than 10 m. (b) Retune the clashes: 1000005 (authored 12 m, resolved 58 m), try bearing 100 → about 112-120 so it sits NW of 1000001, target gap 25 m or less; (1010004, 'east00') (authored 40, resolved 76, an 82 m trail), try bearing 120-150 or move the anchor, target 35 m or less; 1000006 (authored 64 m), try about 40-45 m on a bearing that clears the Dangerous Forest. (c) In build_trail, for mid-sections longer than about 25-30 m, sweep a Catmull-Rom path through 1-2 seeded lateral waypoints offset 6-12 m. Keep fence rails only where the side drop exceeds 2 m. Plant shrub and tree clumps along long trails. Give steep flanks a top-edge fringe, Rock_Cliff_Stone outcrops every 4-6 m and toe bushes. Round the walls of cuts through hill skirts (e.g. the 1000003 cut) to 35 degrees or less. (d) Make the last 4 m into an arrival map follow the axis of the arrival path (the SFoF rim road), not a 90-degree turn on the map edge. Optional: raise the plinth outline wobble to 3-4 m on edges without portals (iter1 9a); keep Southperry's front edge exempt.
shared_fixes.rationale: I viewed Region_WestAmherstForests myself. The three dead-straight fenced runways (to 1000005, 1000006 and 1010004) form a 'circuit board' comb in every island and region shot. That is the main thing still making DoD 14 (connections) and 21 (overview) partial.

shared_fixes.area: Main-road continuity (mapkit constant, trails.py stair treads; per-map one-liners are in the map lists). Wave 0 for the constant.
shared_fixes.fix: Second request (iter1 #12; m.main_path was never built). m.path already accepts mat=, so no new helper is needed. Export a constant such as mapkit.MAIN_ROAD = dict(mat='M_Main_Road', width=3.6) and document it in AUTHORING.md, so map authors switch their through-route ribbon with one line (listed per map). In trails.py, give stone flights on main-road trails (30000→40000, 40002→50000) M_Main_Road treads with stone risers and cheeks. Amherst's cobble street is a deliberate exception. Acceptance: Island_WorldMapStyle shows one continuous cream line from the NW tip through the fork to Southperry, and from the fork through Amherst to the east fields.
shared_fixes.rationale: The two critics disagree. The island critic says the road is a dashed line; the DoD auditor says it is traceable. My own read of Island_WorldMapStyle breaks the tie: the road shows only as cream stubs between maps, joined by brown in-map trails, so you can follow it only by hopping from plate to plate. Making it continuous also removes the colour seam at every portal.

shared_fixes.fix: The strand is already r 0.07, so thickness is not the problem. The problem is that it stands off the face as a stiff diagonal, with a hooked knob on top. Hang the strand plumb, within about 0.12 m of the cliff face below the lip (use the _climb_lip direction or face_point), with its foot at the face base and a small rope_coil there. Remove the top torus knob, and make the stake shorter and lower so the strand dominates. Use a lighter hemp colour with darker knot bands about every 0.4 m and an ink outline, so it contrasts with both the dirt walls and the grey rock. Keep the traversal climb-position behaviour intact. Re-check the 40001, 1020000, 30000 and 50000 Gameplay renders. Maps 1000003 and 1000004 then swap their local hemp_rope copies for m.ladder(kind='rope'), and 30000 aligns its _rope_visual (see the map lists).
shared_fixes.rationale: Three critics independently say ropes read as shepherd's crooks or posts. 40001 has only ropes, and 1020000's identity is its 12 climbables, so this is the main gap in DoD 12 (traversal readable).

shared_fixes.area: Docs and deliverables (scripts/build_island.py, README.md, docs/). Mandatory closing step: do it after the final build, whatever its rank.
shared_fixes.fix: (1) Call scripts/export_manifest.py (or import its main) at the end of build_island.py, so docs/manifest.json and MAPLE_ISLAND_MANIFEST.md are rebuilt every time. Today they date from 03:53 and still say Built='placeholder', with empty traversal, NPC and monster columns and stale trail lengths and base z. (2) Expand README '## Known limitations' to 6-10 concrete bullets, each pointing to DEFERRED.md or VALIDATION.md: interiors staged remotely with no visual link to their doors; trail lengths are not to classic scale; the one-way Mushroom Town chain is physically two-way; proxies are static; platform translation is approximate; and any props_near_routes residuals. (3) Produce renders/final with build_island.py -- --render final: the Island Overview, Hero and WorldMapStyle shots, the five Region shots, and all 25 Overview/Gameplay pairs. Check that the README image link resolves. (4) Delete MapleIsland.blend1 or ignore it. (5) Add a 'Phase 5: island-wide review 2' table to ITERATION_LOG.md. (6) Append the accepted residuals and Iteration Two candidates to DEFERRED.md.
shared_fixes.rationale: Two required deliverables are not produced: the final validation renders folder, and the manifest, which is stale and contradicts the README. The README's limitations section is also too thin to meet the brief. All of this is cheap, but nothing else closes it.

shared_fixes.area: Mushroom Town framing (world.scenery, layout.RIDGES[0], world.island hull). Parallel with the map wave.
shared_fixes.fix: No new houses, since one house per map is on-data; the landmark scale-ups are in the map lists for 0, 20000 and 30000. (a) Within about 60 m of maps 0/10000/20000/30000, replace the dense Tree_Round carpet with a grassySoil treatment: about 25% of today's density (spacing 14 m or more), mostly single big oaks (Tree_Round_A/B at scale 1.6-2.2) in 2-3 groves, meadow flower and grass-tuft clumps, and a warmer golden-green ground tint. (b) Suppress filler trees and the R2-12 shrub ring in the gaps between the 0, 10000 and 20000 plinths, and add a few lamps along those trails, so they read as village lanes rather than forest causeways. (c) Scatter decorative giant toadstools and pale stalk-mushroom clusters on the town's hill skirts. (d) Move the RIDGES[0] points 30-45 m beyond the back edges of maps 0/10000/20000 and wrap them round the west of map 0. Add a 'pocket' support polygon to the hull points (like lake_poly(extra=30)), so the peaks place while RIM_MARGIN[0] keeps map 0's own edge tight. Log every rejected ridge point with its reason.
shared_fixes.rationale: In Region_MushroomTownArea (viewed) the town reads as three separate farmsteads in a dense forest carpet, and at island scale it has no peak-ringed pocket. Of the three named towns in the DoD, it is the only one that doesn't read at region or island scale. A shared plinth would fix it properly but is an Iteration Two layout change.

shared_fixes.area: Waterfall and cliff (world.lake). Parallel with the map wave.
shared_fixes.fix: Extend the lower sheet's forward distance to where its ray meets lake_outline, or add a short flat stream at water_z with a foam strip from the sheet foot to the lake edge. Move the lower Waterfall_Mist ring onto the water. Do not move the lake; it is tuned to 40001's sightline. Rebuild the crescent cliff in the terrace language: 2-3 stepped, irregular tiers with a fringed grass cap and warm khaki strata (not grey M_Rock_Cliff), with Rock_Cliff_Stone in the faces, hanging vines and a wet band behind the falls. Place 2-3 Mountain_Peak_Rocky flanking and behind the crescent ends, so it reads as a gap in the ridge.
shared_fixes.rationale: From the iso camera, the grey box cliff is the most artificial-looking object on the island, and it sits at the visual centre of every island shot. Its plunge also lands on grass, not in the lake.

shared_fixes.fix: Nodes are route vertices. Join two routes when a vertex of one is within 0.75 m in xy and 0.45 m in z (via ground_z) of a segment of the other. A ladder or rope only links routes that actually walk it. Report every group of routes that contains no portal as orphan_routes (medium), and fail the map if its portals are not all in one group. Write the groups to build_report so fixers can see them. The per-map stitches are already in the map lists. 40000 (AroundKnoll 0.53 m, WestLadders 1.35 m) and 60000 (ToLedgeRopes 1.11 m) have real steps, not just undeclared joins.
shared_fixes.rationale: '25/25 traversal ok' currently proves only route fragments. 14 maps have route groups that are not shown to connect, and three of those gaps are real steps that could leave platforms unreachable.

shared_fixes.area: grass_rock style (materials M_Rock_Cliff, geo.terrace). Wave 0, because map builds import geo.
shared_fixes.fix: Second request (iter1 #13; only the material swap landed). Warm the base to about #8a7d6b-#9a8a72. Domain-warp the strata with noise at 2-3 band scales, and add a vertical crack and darkening mask so the bands of neighbouring stones don't line up. In geo.terrace for style grass_rock, inset the bottom ring 10-20% (a taper), or bulge mid-height for r < 2.5 m, and auto-scatter 1-3 Rock_Cliff_Stone instances on camera-facing faces. Re-render the 40001 Gameplay and 40000 Overview.
shared_fixes.rationale: Every Maple Road rock landmark (the 40001 arch and pillar, the 40000 spire and blocks, the 40002 chimney and crest, the 50000 trio) reads as a corrugated silo or a stack of coins, and clashes with the warm dirt walls beside them.

shared_fixes.fix: Support an optional module constant OVERVIEW_EXTRA = [(x0, y0, x1, y1), ...] of local bounding boxes, merged into the Overview fit points for exterior maps. Map 60000 sets it to (60, -9, 92, 0).
shared_fixes.rationale: Southperry's canonical Overview cuts the moored ship off at the bottom of the frame. The ship is the port's signature.

shared_fixes.area: Special trail endings (trails.py, layout.py) and arrival occlusion (world.scenery). Parallel with the map wave.
shared_fixes.fix: (a) Hidden trails: build turf steps (M_Grass treads, M_Dirt_Cliff risers, no stone landings), or allow a grass ramp up to about 27 degrees, instead of M_StoneWall flights. Keep the hedges and no signs. Today the 1020000 → 1020001 lane is the most path-like trail on the island. (b) Bridge endings: add a per-anchor table, BRIDGE_END = {(1000006, 'out00'): 8.0}. Stop the causeway and its flanks about 8 m before the portal, and span the rest with planks on rope rails (width about 3.0 m) with nothing underneath. Keep the Sign_Arrow on the causeway end. Map 1000006 pulls its hub lip back (see its list). (c) Keep filler trees out of an about 8 m band on 1000006's camera-facing side and along the in05 trail, leaving only shrubs there; Dangerous Forest pines currently fill the bottom-right of its Gameplay frame.
shared_fixes.rationale: These two arrivals contradict their briefs: the 'hidden' lane is a cobbled stair, and 1000006's floating arrival hub reads as the end of a ridge.

shared_fixes.fix: Second request (iter1 #6). Skip the landing when the ground index reports the cap height (within 0.05 m) at p1 + 0.3 m along the flight direction. Otherwise make the landing flush and 0.03 m thick in the cap material. Maps 40000, 40002 and 50000 then switch their knoll and shoulder flights to stone (see their lists).
shared_fixes.rationale: Plank pads lying on grass caps make the knolls in three Snail and Split Road maps read as loose boardwalk pieces.

shared_fixes.fix: Set BODY_Z = (0.15, PLAYER_HEIGHT). Skip props whose nearest route segment is a climb within CLIMB_RADIUS of a ladder or rope. Use an interior clearance of about 0.8 m, or exempt hop-able furniture with a top under 0.6 m. Exempt archways whose opening spans the route. Record the obstacle_bvh and blend-ribbon exceptions that are swallowed today in build_report. Grade near-route hits by body clearance: medium below 0.45 m, low otherwise. Target: together with the map nudges, a props_near_routes 'yes' row in the final VALIDATION.md.
shared_fixes.rationale: VALIDATION.md has an open NO with 35 findings, mostly interior false positives. DoD 23 asks for clean scene organisation.

shared_fixes.area: Cheap world polish (world.scenery, kit/markers). Optional, if time allows.
shared_fixes.fix: Give Mountain_Peak_C and Mountain_Hill the ground grass tint (M_Grass or M_Hill), so they stop reading as olive blobs. Jitter the RIDGES[4] SW rim hills ±12 m perpendicular to the polyline, use radius 6-16, cluster them in 2s and 3s with gaps, sink them 30-50% into the ground, and put trees or rocks on about half. Make door-portal threshold glows taller and brighter (Portal_Door), so interior entries such as Sen's house read as well as the edge beams.
shared_fixes.rationale: These are small parameter changes that remove the row of identical gumdrops on the SW rim and the olive domes visible in the island shots. Everything else in this area is Iteration Two.

Amherst Gameplay and Region_AmherstArea. Minor island-scale read items are in the 1010000 list.

Strong at map scale throughout.
Real arch voids, the quay cliff, ravines, multi-level Amherst, the vertical forests.

True of the scene and renders. Only the stale manifest still says 'placeholder' (shared #7).
A large improvement on iter1 (lake, ridges, rim port, sea). Remaining: the rubble-like cloud collar, the runway comb in the forest cluster, the grey waterfall box and the dashed main road.
Composed throughout, but the Southperry Gameplay frame has no characters and the boarding point is hidden. The player is missing or out of frame in many maps.
